SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

Central Station. File No Misc. 522/42 Date July 31st, 1942.

SUBJECT: Board of Enquiry re Misc. 518/42 i.e.
Enquiries on behalf of Public Health
Dept.

Sir,

On July 28, 1942, the undersigned having been nominated by the Commissioner of Police to attend the Board of Enquiry in connection with S/O H 3/1344 dated July 24, 1942 and Central Misc. 518/42 July 10, 1942 i.e. Enquiries on behalf of Public Health Dept.

With regard to the above at 10.30a.m. on July 30, 1942, the Board of Enquiry was held in the Council Chamber and at which Messrs R. Bohlke, manager of "Bayer" Pharma Co. 138 Kiangse Road, Mr. R.T. Bryan, Municipal Advocate and the undersigned attended.

Mr. Bohlke was elected Chairman, and Miss M.A. Diniz appointed Recording Secretary.

The undersigned outlined the result of enquiries made by detectives of Central Station on this case.

It was recalled that when detectives interviewed Dr. Pack he requested that enquiries be instituted regarding a certain Russian name Ginch who was suspected of possibly being connected with the disappearance of the missing medicine. Other parts of the investigation were conducted by officials of the Department concerned.

No report of the investigation conducted by the Health Department have yet been forwarded to members of the Board for their perusal. It was therefore decided that copies of the complete file of the various reports made by the P.H.D. and S.M.C. should be supplied to all members of the Board on Saturday morning, August 1, 1942.

（左侧方框内文字：巡捕房 警 察）

报告

中央捕房。档案号 Misc. 522/42 日期 1942年7月31日。

事由：关于 Misc. 518/42 的调查委员会，即
代表公共卫生处进行的调查。

先生，

1942年7月28日，鉴于警务总监提名本人出席与1942年7月24日的 S/O H 3/1344 号令及1942年7月10日的中央杂项档案 518/42（即代表公共卫生处进行的调查）有关的调查委员会，本人遂出席该委员会。

关于上述事项，调查委员会于1942年7月30日上午10时30分在公议局议事厅举行，出席者有江西路138号“拜耳”制药公司经理 R. Bohlke 先生、市法律顾问 R.T. Bryan 先生以及本人。

Bohlke 先生被选为主席，M.A. Diniz 小姐被任命为记录秘书。

本人概述了中央捕房侦探就本案进行调查的结果。

据回忆，当侦探询问 Pack 医生时，他要求对一名名为 Ginch 的俄国人展开调查，此人涉嫌可能与药品失踪案有关。调查的其他部分由相关部门官员进行。

卫生处进行的调查报告尚未提交给委员会成员审阅。因此决定，于1942年8月1日（星期六）上午，向委员会所有成员提供公共卫生处（P.H.D.）和工部局（S.M.C.）所作各项报告的完整档案副本。

（左侧方框内文字：巡捕房 警 察）
（左侧椭圆印章：上海公共租界警务处 / 1942年8月1日 / 副总监 / 刑事及特别科）
（左下角圆形印章：刑事科 / 17. 8. 1 / 小林）

page_data.en:
Mr. Bryan agreed to supply M. Bohlke and the
undersigned with copies of the reports on the case.
The request was agreed to and permission granted
by the Chairman.
The undersigned then requested the Chairman to
authorize the Police to institute a full enquiry into
the case and permit them to interrogate all and any
person connected with the Department concerned, should
such interrogation be deemed necessary towards clearing
this case up.
The Chairman readily acceded to this request.
The following decision was handed down by the
Board of Enquiry at the conclusion of this meeting:-
1. That Mr. A.M. Giles should appear before
the Board of Enquiry during the proceedings
and be permitted to cross-examine any
witnesses against him.
2. That the next hearing should take place at
10a.m. 6-8-42, at which time Mr. Giles
should appear and the proceedings commence.
3. That in the meantime the Police should make
further inquiries and collect as much evidence
as possible.
Copies of the Police reports Misc. 518/42 were
delivered to the Chairman and Mr. Bryan direct on the
morning of 31-7-42, instead of passing through the
usual channels.

He is married and it appears that he came from
a good family.

Inquiries have also been made by D.I. Ovsianikoff
at the Medical Hospital Supply House & Mr. A.G.Gulnik,

He is prepared to guarantee the suspect's honesty

regarding this man are groundless, and can be regarded
as a person above any suspicion.

SUBJECT: Enquiries on behalf of Public Health Dept.

At 10.35a.m. 10-7-42 in response to a telephoned request the undersigned accompanied by C.D.C. 175 interviewed Dr. Duck of the Public Health Dept.

Dr. Duck explained as follows:-

A report had been submitted by a Chinese in the Dispensing Dept., to the effect that since the last stocktaking in December 1941 certain drugs had been taken away from the dispensary store room and he (the Chinese) was afraid that when the loss was discovered suspicion would be cast upon the Chinese who slept in a room adjoining said storeroom. The Chinese intimated that the missing drugs may have been taken away by a certain Russian Drug broker named "Ginch" who called at the dispensary on frequent occasions and carried out certain tasks, such as sharpening medical needles etc, for the S.M.C.

It was further explained by Dr. Duck, that as far as discreet Departmental enquiries could ascertain, Dextrose, Rivanol, and 100 ozs of quinine, total value more than $10,000 were missing.

Mr. Giles, a dispenser who has been in the employ of the S.M.C. since 1937 is really responsible for the safe custody of the drugs, and it is reasonable to suppose that he should have noticed the disappearance of such a large quantity of quinine even supposing same had been removed in small amounts. However this part of the investigation is being conducted by the Department concerned and Dr. Duck explained that the object of calling in the police was to have enquiries instituted regarding the man Ginch.

So far police enquiries rather point to the man

事由：代表公共卫生处进行的调查。

1942年7月10日上午10时35分，应电话请求，本人会同 C.D.C. 175 号警员会晤了公共卫生处的 Duck 医生。

Duck 医生解释如下：-

配药部的一名华人提交了一份报告，称自1941年12月最后一次盘点以来，某些药品从配药室仓库中被拿走，他（该华人）担心一旦损失被发现，嫌疑会落到睡在该仓库隔壁房间的那名华人身上。该华人暗示，失踪的药品可能是被一名名为“Ginch”的俄国药品经纪人拿走的，此人经常到访配药室，并为工部局执行某些任务，如磨尖医用针头等。

Duck 医生进一步解释说，据部门内部谨慎调查所能确定的情况，葡萄糖、利凡诺（Rivanol）和100盎司奎宁失踪，总价值超过10,000美元。

Giles 先生是一名配药员，自1937年起受雇于工部局，实际上负责药品的安全保管，按理说即使假设药品是分批少量被移走的，他也应该注意到如此大量奎宁的失踪。然而，这部分调查正由相关部门进行，Duck 医生解释说，召请警方的目的是要对 Ginch 这个人展开调查。

到目前为止，警方的调查更倾向于指向该

（印：刑事科私人助理）

page_data.en:
referred to being one named G.H. Ginh (Russian) former
salesman for Religious Hospital Supply House, 2 Peking
Road. From details elicited it appears rather doubtful
that he could have obtained the drugs unaided and the
general suspicion is that Giles may be in collusion.
It must be clearly understood however, that so far there
is no concrete evidence against either party.

With regard to the source of information it is
understood the Chinese in question is the third
generation of his family to work in the department and
is at present believed to be above suspicion.

It is obvious that enquiries regarding Mr. Ginh
will be extremely difficult, but no effort will be
spared to elicit some useful information in this
direction. The assistance of D.I. Ovsianikoff has
been enlisted and the best course to adopt is at present
under consideration.

Dr. Duck has requested that copies of police reports
be delivered to him direct instead of passing through
the usual channels. Subject to the necessary approval
the undersigned proposes to hand such reports to Dr.
Duck personally.

（批：Any objection to this proposal?）

H 3/1344.

July 23, 42.

The Manager,
Messrs. Bayer Pharma Co.,
138 Kiangse Road,
Shanghai.

Sir,

The Commissioner of Public Health recently reported
to the Council that certain drugs were missing from the stocks
kept in the dispensary of the Municipal Health Department.
In view of the peculiar circumstances of the case the Council
has deemed it necessary that an enquiry be held into the matter
with a view, if possible, to determining the responsibility for
the loss of the drugs. The Council, therefore, has set up a
board of enquiry consisting of the Municipal Advocate, a Senior
Police Officer and a third person. It has been suggested that
the third person be Mr. P. Boehlke of your firm.

I am directed to enquire whether you will kindly
permit Mr. Boehlke of your firm to serve as a member of the
board and to thank you in advance for cooperation in this matter.

I am, Sir,

your obedient servant,

K. TERAOKA
Secretary.

先生，

公共卫生总监最近向工部局报告称，市卫生局
配药室库存中的某些药品失踪。鉴于本案情况特殊，
工部局认为有必要对此事进行调查，以便尽可能确定
药品损失的责任。因此，工部局成立了一个调查委员会，
成员包括市法律顾问、一名资深警官和第三人。有人建议
第三人由贵公司的 P. Boehlke 先生担任。

奉命询问，贵公司是否肯允准 Boehlke 先生
担任委员会成员，并预先感谢阁下在此事上的合作。

我是，先生，

您顺从的仆人，

K. TERAOKA
秘书。

1942年7月10日上午10时35分，应电话请求，本人会同 C.D.C. 175 号警员会晤了公共卫生处的 Duck 医生。
Duck 医生解释如下：-
配药部的一名华人提交了一份报告，称自1941年12月最后一次盘点以来，某些药品从配药室仓库中被拿走，他（该华人）担心一旦损失被发现，嫌疑会落到睡在该仓库隔壁房间的那名华人身上。该华人暗示，失踪的药品可能是被一名名为“Ginch”的俄国药品经纪人拿走的，此人经常到访配药室，并为工部局执行某些任务，如磨尖医用针头等。
Duck 医生进一步解释说，据部门内部谨慎调查所能确定的情况，葡萄糖、利凡诺（Rivanol）和100盎司奎宁失踪，总价值超过10,000美元。
Giles 先生是一名配药员，自1937年起受雇于工部局，实际上负责药品的安全保管，按理说即使假设药品是分批少量被移走的，他也应该注意到如此大量奎宁的失踪。然而，这部分调查正由相关部门进行，Duck 医生解释说，召请警方的目的是要对 Ginch 这个人展开调查。
到目前为止，警方的调查更倾向于指向该

page_data.en:
A]

referred to being one named G.N. Ginh (Russian) former
salesman for Medicus Hospital Supply House, 2 Peking
Road. From details elicited it appears rather doubtful
that he could have obtained the drugs unaided and the
general suspicion is that Giles may be in collusion.
It must be clearly understood however, that so far there
is no concrete evidence against either party.

With regard to the source of information it is
understood the Chinese in question is the third
generation of his family to work in the department and
is at present believed to be above suspicion.

It is obvious that enquiries regarding Mr. Ginh
will be extremely difficult, but no effort will be
spared to elicit some useful information in this
direction. The assistance of D.I. Ovsian nikoff has
been enlisted and the best course to adopt is at present
under consideration.

Dr. Duck has requested that copies of police reports
be delivered to him direct instead of passing through
the usual channels. Subject to the necessary approval
the undersigned proposes to hand such reports to Dr.
Duck personally.

D. S. I.

所提及者系一名名为 G.N. Ginh（俄国人）的男子，曾任北京路2号 Medicus 医院供应行（Medicus Hospital Supply House）的推销员。从已获取的细节来看，他似乎不太可能独自获得这些药物，普遍的怀疑是 Giles 可能与其串通。然而，必须明确的是，截至目前，针对任何一方均无确凿证据。

关于情报来源，据悉该华人是其家族中第三代在该部门工作的人员，目前被认为无可疑之处。

显然，对 Ginh 先生的调查将极为困难，但我们将不遗余力地在此方向上获取一些有用信息。已寻求 D.I. Ovsian nikoff 的协助，目前正在考虑最佳行动方案。

Misc.518/42    July 27th, 1942.

Enquiries on behalf of Public Health Dept.

So far efforts to locate the Russian, Ginh, have
proved unsuccessful but it is expected that he may be
contacted within the next few days. All that can be
learned of him is that he resides some where in the
Western District O.O.L. and does not appear to be
registered with any society etc. He was apparently never
officially connected with the Medicus Hospital supply
house, the manager of which concern will call at Central
on 28-7-42 to offer whatever information he has regarding
the man sought. As Police enquiries in connection with
thiscase only concern the Russian, no report other than t
original has been submitted as there has been no
information to impart.

Enquiries proceeding.

D. E. I.

应公共卫生处要求进行的调查

截至目前，寻找该俄国人 Ginh 的努力尚未成功，但预计在未来几天内可能与其取得联系。目前所能了解到的情况是，他居住在西区某处（O.O.L.），且似乎未在任何社团等机构注册。他显然从未与 Medicus 医院供应行有正式关联，该行经理将于1942年7月28日前往中央巡捕房，提供其所掌握的关于此人的任何信息。由于警方对此案的调查仅涉及该俄国人，且并无新信息可报，故除原始报告外未提交其他报告。

G.N. Gih, Russian Subject, residing at Apt. 18,
127C Yu Yuen Road was questioned by D.I. Ovsianikoff
as to what he did & how he conducted business with
the Health Dept. (P.H.D.) for the last 4 years. He has
also similar business transactions with Health Dept of
the French Municipal Council. He was previously employed
for a considerable time by Messrs Wondercraft & Coy.
Henderson Building, Nanking Road and by the Office
Appliance Coy. for about 6 months.
He is married and it appears that he came from
a good family.
Inquiries have also been made by D.I. Ovsianikoff
at the Federal Hospital Supply House & Mr. A.G.Gulnik,
proprietor of the firm stated that during his association
with Mr. G.N. Gih, he found him to be a very honest
and straightforward person. He does not think that
G.N. Gih could be in any way involved in the possible
theft of medicines from the P.H.D. (S.M.C.).
He is prepared to guarantee the suspect's honesty
in every respect. After looking over the suspect
D.I. Ovsianikoff is also of the opinion that suspicions
regarding this man are groundless, and can be regarded
as a person above any suspicion.

3.

俄国籍人士 G.N. Gih，居住于愚园路127C号18室，由 D.I. Ovsianikoff 就其在过去四年间所为及如何与公共卫生处（P.H.D.）开展业务一事进行了问讯。他与法公董局卫生处也有类似的商业往来。他此前曾在南京路亨德森大楼（Henderson Building）的 Wondercraft & Coy. 公司任职相当长一段时间，并在 Office Appliance Coy. 公司工作了约六个月。
他已婚，且似乎出身良家。
D.I. Ovsianikoff 亦向 Federal Hospital Supply House 进行了查询，该行店主 A.G. Gulnik 先生表示，在与 G.N. Gih 先生交往期间，发现他是一位非常诚实正直的人。他认为 G.N. Gih 不可能以任何方式卷入从工部局公共卫生处（S.M.C.）盗窃药品的嫌疑案件中。
他愿意为该嫌疑人在各方面的诚实品行作保。在审视该嫌疑人后，D.I. Ovsianikoff 也认为针对此人的怀疑毫无根据，可将其视为无可疑之人。
据 Gih 称，公共卫生处办公室内总有几名中国人在场，此外，他对
